title: Les Mills vs City Fitness NZ — Which Is Better Value in 2026?
meta_desc: Les Mills vs City Fitness NZ comparison. Which gym offers better value in 2026?
intro: When it comes to choosing a gym in New Zealand, two popular options stand out: Les Mills and City Fitness NZ. With various locations across the country, both franchises offer a range of facilities and services. However, their prices and contract terms differ significantly, making it essential to compare them before making a decision.

sections.heading: Facilities and Services
sections.body: Both Les Mills and City Fitness NZ offer state-of-the-art facilities, including cardio equipment, free weights, and group fitness studios. However, Les Mills is known for its high-quality group fitness classes, with over 100 classes per week, including popular programs like BodyPump and RPM. City Fitness NZ, on the other hand, offers a more limited selection of around 50 classes per week.

sections.heading: Contract Terms
sections.body: Les Mills requires a 12-month contract, with a joining fee of $99. City Fitness NZ offers a more flexible 6-month contract, with a joining fee of $49. It's essential to consider these terms before signing up, as they can have a significant impact on your overall costs and commitment.

sections.heading: Locations
list: Les Mills: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton
City Fitness NZ: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Tauranga

sections.heading: Group Fitness Quality
sections.body: Les Mills is renowned for its high-quality group fitness classes, with experienced instructors and a wide range of programs. City Fitness NZ also offers group fitness classes, but the quality and variety may not be as high as Les Mills. If group fitness is a priority for you, Les Mills may be the better option.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Ultimately, the decision between Les Mills and City Fitness NZ depends on your individual needs and priorities. If you're looking for a more affordable option with flexible contract terms, City Fitness NZ may be the better choice. However, if you're willing to commit to a 12-month contract and prioritize high-quality group fitness classes, Les Mills may be worth the extra cost.
